title: Pre-processed SSRS report via generate_object preProcess=true (DP extends SrsReportDataProviderPreProcess; doubles as Phase F compile-verification of the preprocess scaffold shape)
instruction: In the sandbox model, ground first with get_knowledge(topic="ssrs-rdp-preprocess") and get_knowledge(topic="ssrs-reports"), then use generate_object(mode="scaffold", objectType="report", name="DemoNoteReportPre", caption="@TaxTransactionInquiry:HeaderNote", fieldsHint="NoteId, Subject", preProcess=true, generateController=true) to scaffold a 6-object pre-processed SSRS report: a tmp table, a DataContract, a Data Provider that extends SrsReportDataProviderPreProcess (no [SRSReportParameterAttribute] -- the contract is passed via the Controller -- and with an auto-generated preProcess() stub), a Controller, an output menu item, and the AxReport. Keep the generated preProcess() stub and complete processReport(): populate the tmp table with NoteId/Subject rows from a local ConDemoNoteHeader variable via insert_recordset. All 6 objects must build clean. IMPLEMENTER NOTE (golden capture, Phase F verification): the preProcess=true scaffold pairing is NOT yet compile-proven on any VM golden. If the build rejects SrsReportDataProviderPreProcess with the scaffold's TempDB tmp table (regular-table staging keyed by createdTransactionId is what that base expects), switch the DP base class to SrsReportDataProviderPreProcessTempDB (or adjust the tmp table's TableType to Regular with a createdTransactionId column -- whichever the compiler accepts with the fewest deviations from the scaffold) and record in the corpus evidence which base-class/table-type pairing actually compiled, so the scaffold and the ssrs-rdp-preprocess knowledge topic can be corrected.
